payload.reason: The evidence provides specific comparisons of the SATA-LSTM model against various baseline models, including both syntactic and latent tree-based models.

claims.text: The SATA-LSTM model was compared against neural models built on syntactic trees, latent trees, and non-tree models.
The comparison included models such as Latent Syntax Tree-LSTM, Tree-based CNN, Gumbel Tree-LSTM, and others.
The model was also evaluated against a fully-connected layer and Bi-LSTM in an ablation study.
